$comment: Every repository here was read by a human, and every expected finding below was
checked against the source and judged correct-as-stated. Commits are PINNED so a
drift in this corpus means OUR behaviour changed, never that upstream did.
`expected` lists finding codes with their occurrence count. `notes` records WHY a
finding is expected — several are known false positives kept deliberately, so that
when one is fixed the harness fails and forces this file to be updated rather than

repos.name: node-express-boilerplate
repos.why: Express + Mongoose + Passport monolith with compose override files. Exercises compose-override unification and Maven-free manifest naming.

notes.IR-LINT-DIRECT-DB-ACCESS-002: Known limitation, kept: the app is one gateway node, so this reports 'no service layer visible' rather than asserting a defect. The repo IS layered (controllers -> services -> models).
notes.IR-LINT-NO-HEALTHCHECK-003: TRUE. src/routes/v1 has auth, user and docs routes only; no health endpoint anywhere.

repos.name: lokalise-node-service-template
repos.why: Fastify + drizzle + @fastify/jwt. Regression guard for object-form route detection and scoped auth-plugin detection.

notes.IR-LINT-DIRECT-DB-ACCESS-002: Manifest-only edge, so it arrives low-confidence and hedged.
notes.IR-LINT-ISOLATED-NODE-005: fauxqs, a local SQS/SNS emulator, genuinely has no depends_on. Factually true, low value.
notes.absent-NO-HEALTHCHECK: Must NOT fire: /live is declared via app.route({ url }) and is detected since the Fastify object-form fix.
notes.absent-MISSING-AUTH: Must NOT fire: @fastify/jwt is detected as an auth node.

repos.name: spring-petclinic
repos.why: Java: pom.xml + compose + k8s, no code analyser. Guards Maven parent-POM naming, whose fix also unifies the manifest and Kubernetes views by canonical id.

notes.clean: Zero findings. The component must be named 'petclinic' from <name>, never 'spring-boot-starter-parent' from the inherited <parent> block.

repos.name: example-voting-app
repos.why: Polyglot monorepo, compose + k8s, several services built from subdirectories. Guards against over-eager scan-root merging.

notes.sut-must-stay-separate: The `sut` test harness builds from ./tests/ and must NOT fold into the app root. An earlier build-context heuristic wrongly merged it.
notes.IR-LINT-MISSING-AUTH-010: Known limitation: fires on the whole-app node, which carries the same weakness DIRECT-DB-ACCESS shed.

repos.name: full-stack-fastapi-template
repos.why: Python + compose with an override that re-declares `db` without an image. Direct regression guard for the type-specificity bug that relabelled Postgres as a gateway.

notes.db-must-be-postgres: compose.yml declares `db: image: postgres:18`; compose.override.yml re-declares `db` with only ports. The identified postgres type must win over the guessed gateway.
notes.known-noise: adminer / proxy / traefik are dev tooling promoted to gateways on published ports; the MISSING-AUTH and ISOLATED-NODE counts reflect that unresolved limitation.

repos.name: eShopOnWeb
repos.why: .NET + compose. Only corpus entry exercising the C# analyser path.

notes.known-noise: An [Authorize] auth node IS detected but is not connected to the compose-derived gateways, so MISSING-AUTH fires anyway. Fixing that linkage should drop these to 0 and update this entry.

repos.name: microservices-demo
repos.why: Kubernetes-native polyglot. Tracks the *_SERVICE_ADDR extraction gap — the largest known scan-quality deficit.

notes.resolved-2026-08: Was 12 isolated nodes, caused by the Kubernetes extractor ignoring *_SERVICE_ADDR wiring. With those edges extracted the graph is the real Online Boutique topology (21 edges), and the counts below were re-adjudicated against it.
notes.IR-LINT-ISOLATED-NODE-005: TRUE, both of them. opentelemetrycollector is referenced by no env address anywhere in the manifests, and the terraform state bucket is genuinely standalone infrastructure.
notes.IR-LINT-HIGH-FANOUT-004: TRUE. frontend calls 8 services and checkoutservice calls 6; that is the actual shape of this application and worth surfacing.
notes.IR-LINT-SYNC-CHAIN-001: TRUE. ingress → frontend → checkoutservice → leaf is a real 4-hop synchronous chain.
notes.IR-LINT-DEAD-NODE-011: Rose from 2 to 6 because the graph is now connected: adservice, emailservice, paymentservice and currencyservice are leaf gRPC services that legitimately terminate. Same known weakness as auth nodes — the rule fires on anything that receives without emitting. Not a regression from this change.
